description: Day 3 silent mutation for GLORI_001. The Fieldstone submission requirements drift after most of the package is built.

requests.description: Cut the Fieldstone template page limit from 12 to 10 and add a required letters of support attachment. TR-02.
requests.rationale: The page limit and attachment change must be caught at T11 and carried into the T13 package check. An agent that trusts the original requirements ships a noncompliant package.
